name: Basilica of the Opportune
description: An ancient Orzhov church that Terrik's wurm collapsed, killing nearly two dozen workers; its catacombs hold the Izzet machine.

relations.note: His wurm collapsed it, killing the workers, though the pontiff later admits his own digging was at fault.
relations.quote: I'd ridden my wurm underneath it, compromising its structural support
